title: Indian-Style Lo Mein with Caraway Rice
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired dish made with lo mein, caraway-infused rice, and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add caraway seeds and sauté for 1 minute.
Add onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add lo mein, cabbage, and eggplant and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add garam masala, turmeric, and cumin and stir-fry for another minute.
Add rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Serve with a dollop of raita or a sprinkle of chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
